Subject: Quick follow-up: Redwood demo & next steps

Hi Sara / Samir,

Thanks again for the time today — really enjoyed learning more about how Orion is handling model serving for realtime recommendations. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- What I heard:
  - Primary goal: reduce per-request latency and cut inference cost for the recommendation model while maintaining 99th pct latency SLA for the web tier.
  - Current setup: self-hosted GPU pool, burst to cloud for peak; limited ops resources for maintenance.
  - Main concerns: cold-start latency, KV cache hit rate, and predictable cost at scale.

- How Redwood can help (high level):
  - Dedicated inference pools + autoscale to keep 99th pct latency predictable
  - Prefix/KV caching to reduce per-token compute on repeated requests
  - Quantization profiles for the recommendation model family we discussed

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll send a short ROI sketch + demo slides (attached)
2) If helpful, set up a technical deep-dive with Dylan (runtime/ops) next week — 45 mins
3) Share a draft SOW for a 6-week pilot to validate perf/cost on a small traffic slice

Attachments: Redwood-demo-slides.pdf (brief deck), SOW-template.docx (pilot template)

Would you be available for the deep-dive next Tue/Wed (Mar 10/11) afternoon PT? If those times don’t work I can propose alternatives.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
